title: Blueberry Baked Oatmeal
changes_from_base: A sweet, cake-like oatmeal: quick oats, brown sugar and baking powder are mixed with milk, eggs and melted butter, folded with blueberries and baked in a square dish, then cut into portions.
summary: This straightforward baked oatmeal studded with bursts of blueberry delivers comfort in every forkful, sweet enough to feel like a treat yet wholesome enough for daily eating.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
whole milk, plus extra to serve

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Preheat oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan) and oil a 20 cm square baking dish.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: In a large bowl whisk 255 g quick-cooking oats, 200 g light brown sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: In a medium bowl whisk 360 ml milk, 2 large eggs, 85 g melted butter (cooled) and 1 tsp vanilla.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir the wet into the dry until just combined, then fold in 150 g blueberries (fresh or frozen, not thawed).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 40-45 min until golden and centre reaches 71 °C.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.text: Cool 10 min on a wire rack, cut into 8 pieces and serve with a splash of milk, reheating portions about 30 s in the microwave as needed.

tips: Freeze your own blueberries or buy them frozen to use year-round in this recipe.
Quick-cooking oats make a more tender, cake-like crumb than rolled or steel-cut varieties.
safety: Check the centre with an instant-read thermometer; it must reach 71 °C for safety.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days; reheat individual portions about 30 s in the microwave until warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
